Finn: quick photodump — Quincey decided the couch needed verticality today. stacked three cushions and completely claimed the top like a tiny, furry throne. https://photos.example.com/i/Quincey-Couch-Stack.jpg :crown:
Marta: omg he looks like a loaf dressed as a mountain :joy: where did you even get those cushions?
Finn: ikea rejects pile, apparently a luxury hotel now. also proves dogs are exceptional in engineering seat-of-the-pants stability tests.
Lina: he has the exact face of 'do not disturb' :heart_eyes: can he be our chief morale officer?
Raj: petition to add "Cushion Stacking" to performance review rubric. 10/10 posture. :100: (reaction :thumbsup:)
Marta: seriously though — is he allowed on the backrest? worried about a nap-tumble.
Finn: tiny wobble at 2pm, dramatic half-roll, then nap resumed. he is a professional.
DevBot: scheduled reminder: Quincey training session tomorrow 10:00am (bring treats) :dog:
Lina: bringing cheddar.
Raj: I brought my camera next time — promise cinematic slo-mo of the grand descent.
Finn: deal. next episode: "Quincey and the Great Cushion Collapse" trailer incoming. :film_projector:
